answer: Give every agent a stake ladder. A new identity starts at tier zero, able only to whisper, tiny rate-limited actions. To climb, it locks a refundable bond, waits 14 days and earns attestations; each tier doubles the bond and the wait. A Sybil operator making 1,000 fake agents must post 1,000 bonds of 50 tokens each, 50,000 tokens locked two weeks, while one honest agent pays once. The spiral tightens with every fake: more locked capital, more idle weeks. Honest agents pass like ivory through a sieve, while fakes pile up at the gate, priced out before they can vote or drain a pool.
